name: Descript
shortDescription: Edit video and audio by editing the transcript. Free to start; paid plans on their site.
longDescription: Descript edits audio and video from the transcript. The pricing page lists free or hobby language and a $0 figure, with paid samples in a roughly $16–$65 range.
bestFor: Cutting and cleaning talking-head or podcast video
Creators who edit by editing words
notIdealFor: Generating a character voice from scratch as the main job
strength: You edit video and audio by editing the transcript, and the free plan includes 60 minutes of media per month.
weakness: Paid samples on the page ran from about $16 to $65, so a single monthly starting price was not clear.

useCaseFit.game-creative: Edits video by editing the transcript, with 60 free media minutes a month.
useCaseFit.listing-videos: Edits the video by editing the transcript and adds captions.
